ns2:section.sectionText: Algorithms for Big Data This course will describe some algorithmic techniques that have been developed for handling large amounts of data which may not fit in memory or is available in limited ways. Topics include data stream algorithms, sampling and sketching techniques, and sparsification methods, with applications to signals, matrices, and graphs. Emphasis will be on theoretical aspects of the design and analysis of such algorithms. Prerequisite: grades of at least B+ in CS 374 and CS 361, or comparable understanding and facility with algorithms and probability.
